name: Isabela Rodriguez
bio: Isabela is a driven and successful lawyer specializing in international business law. Raised in Havana, she excelled academically and pursued her postgraduate studies abroad, returning to Cuba with a global perspective and a determination to contribute to her country's economic development. While fiercely independent and protective of her private life, Isabela possesses a warm and supportive nature, always ready to offer a helping hand to those she cares about. She seeks a partner who is equally ambitious, intelligent, and capable of understanding the demands of her career, someone who appreciates both her glamorous side and her quieter moments.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, styled with soft curls that cascade down her back
physical.description: Isabela has a striking presence, accentuated by her high cheekbones and full lips. Her elegant style and poised demeanor project confidence and sophistication.

meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by a major sponsor of the player's motorsport team.
firstImpression: Her confident stride and intelligent gaze immediately command attention; she seems both poised and approachable.
dealBreakers: Inability to engage in intellectual conversation
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Isabela appreciates a partner who demonstrates their affection through practical gestures and thoughtful actions that ease her busy life.
